verdict.rationale: Community commenters describe K3 as an open-weight, open-source model, which implies the core model could be run on one's own infrastructure. But no first-party docs describe self-hosting, and the documented Kimi Code CLI and assistant require logging in to the hosted Kimi Code platform. missing for 10: first-party self-hosting or deployment documentation, published weight downloads or licensing, a self-hostable assistant/CLI backend, and hands-on reports of a successful self-hosted deployment.
